HOME SCIENCE MARCH — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

19. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.

21. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Convenience Foods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Pastry Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Yeast Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Food and Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Care of the Home: Exterior Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
